scope: we isolated exosomes from serum samples of 30 patients with three distinct neurodegenerative diseases and performed unbiased proteomic analysis

Using the MTNs assay, we isolated the brain-derived blood exosomes from the serum samples of 30 patients with neurodegenerative diseases, such as dementia, PD, and MS, and performed unbiased proteomic analysis to explore the pilot value of 746 exosomal protein profiles as biomarkers by using liquid chromatography − mass spectrometry (LC–MS).
